decisions.reason: Close to the established cutting and creasing offer, the firm can apply existing knowledge to interpret results and improve it.
UV spot varnishing is distant from the firm's mechanical finishing knowledge and without evidence of own R&D the firm lacks absorptive capacity to learn from early results.
Building on the established sheet preparation offer, the firm can leverage related knowledge to assimilate market feedback and improve the product.
Close to the existing multifinishing systems and presented as a focus, the firm has strong related knowledge to interpret results and continue development.
Close to the established saddle stitching offer, the firm can use its existing knowledge to learn from early results and improve the product.
Close to the existing folding offer and already installed at a customer, the firm can build on related knowledge and early positive use.
